message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to query the VirusTotal API directly from here, so I can’t pull the actual CNAME‑record IDs for `sample.com`.  

If you’d like to retrieve those IDs yourself, you can use the following steps (replace `secret123` with your real API key):

```bash
# 1. Get the domain object ID
curl -s -H "x-apikey: secret123" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com" | jq -r '.data.id'

# 2. List all DNS records for that domain
DOMAIN_ID=$(curl -s -H "x-apikey: secret123" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com" | jq -r '.data.id')

curl -s -H "x-apikey: secret123" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/${DOMAIN_ID}/dns_records" | \
     jq -r '.data[] | select(.attributes.type=="CNAME") | .id'
```

The second command will output the IDs of all CNAME records associated with `sample.com`. If you run this locally, you’ll see the exact IDs returned by VirusTotal.
